We understand this is outside your standard published tiers (>20% needs senior signoff), so please advise if there is an internal path to approve this. If helpful, I'm attaching our proposed SOW and usage forecast.

Looking to move quickly — we can sign once terms are cleared.

Best,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Nov 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pricing - request for expanded concession

Ben / Mina — forwarding the ask from Medinova. Quick summary in case you prefer a short read:
- Request: 28% off Hosted API unit rates for 12 months, committed pilot (12 months)
- Expected usage: ramp to ~8M tokens/month by M3; conservative ARR-ish economics if they expand post-pilot
- Terms twist: month-to-month invoicing with commitment; procurement wants net 30

Attached is Ben's model. I ran a sensitivity: at 28% discount, unit contribution margin drops to ~13% on our hosted stack assuming current batch/cache settings. Upside: strong chance to convert to dedicated + volume post-pilot; downside: if they churn after pilot we absorb a lot of cost.

Requesting senior exec signoff for a one-time concession to 28% for this pilot, contingent on: 1) a non-cancellable 12-month commitment with a termination fee for early exit, 2) payment cadence preapproved by Finance (prefer prepay or at least 45-day net on initial invoice), 3) a 15% uplift cap for any additional production scale pricing until dedicated transition.

Can we get signoff or propose alternative (e.g., 22% + expansion credits)? Need a decision by next Tue EOD to keep Medinova's momentum.

-Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_term_summary.docx (docx)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Nov 2028 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing - request for expanded concession

Karthik — I ran the ledger and legal points. Short version: I do not recommend a straight 28% list concession under month-to-month invoicing. The risk here is high for one-sided consumption during the pilot.

If leadership is willing to approve >20%, build these mandatory guardrails:
- Non-cancellable 12-month commitment with a 30% early-termination recoup (applies if they stop before 12 months)
- Initial invoice prepay for first two months (or a refundable security deposit)
- Usage cap alerting and automatic throttling beyond the forecasted monthly token threshold without explicit written approval
- Redwood retains right to convert to Dedicated pricing if sustained >12M tokens/mo for two consecutive months

With those protections, I can model 25% as tolerable; anything beyond that needs CFO-level signoff. Finance prefers prepay but can accept net 45 on the first invoice if procurement gives a written exception.

-Mina
VP, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Nov 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing - request for expanded concession

Team — I reviewed the ask and the mitigations Mina proposed. Medinova is strategically aligned and there is a clear path to convert to Dedicated in 6-9 months if they perform. I will authorize a one-time 25% hosted-rate concession for the 12-month committed pilot under the following non-negotiable conditions:

1) Medinova must sign the attached SOW with the explicit non-cancellable 12-month term and a 30% early-termination fee.
2) Customer must prepay first two months (credit card or wire) or provide a $75k refundable deposit prior to provisioning.
3) Redwood will include automated usage caps and throttles (with alerts) tied to the forecast. Any usage above thresholds requires written approval and will be billed at published list rates until otherwise agreed.
4) Any request to exceed 25% concession (to 28% as requested) must go to CFO for final signoff; this approval is for sales to close at 25% and proceed with contract execution.

Karthik — please communicate terms to Laura and procurement and ask for confirmation on prepay mechanism. Ben — prepare the SOW/CLM package and loop Legal for the termination clause language.

-Stephanie
Senior VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
